title: Show system population on Bookmarks panel
desc: If ON, will show the population of the system in the System Features column in Bookmarks

title: Display icons for place characteristics
desc: If ON, will show icons instead of abbreviated place characteristics in Bookmarks and Places Of Interest

title: Show controlling faction of stations on Bodies and Stations panels
desc: If ON, will show the controlling faction after the station name
